facts.text: The Vidago Palace Hotel was inaugurated on 6 October 1910, the year the First Portuguese Republic was established.
facts.excerpt: it was on the 6th October 1910, the year in which the First Portuguese Republic was established, that the Vidago Palace Hotel was inaugurated

facts.text: King D. Carlos I wished to see a luxury therapeutic spa built in Vidago with international projection.
facts.excerpt: It was in the 19th century that King D. Carlos I wished to see a luxury therapeutic spa built that would have international projection.

facts.text: The hotel is housed in a century-old palace in the heart of the Vidago Thermal Park, surrounded by mountains and forest.
facts.excerpt: housed in a century-old palace in the heart of the Vidago Thermal Park, surrounded by mountains and forest

facts.text: The hotel's golf course was designed by architect Philip Mackenzie Ross.

facts.text: The Spa and Club House were designed by architect Álvaro Siza Vieira.
facts.excerpt: The Spa and Club House were designed by the renowned architect Álvaro Siza Vieira.

facts.text: The interior design is by Portuguese architects José Pedro Lopes Vieira and Diogo Rosa Lã.
facts.excerpt: The interior design is the responsibility of Portuguese architects José Pedro Lopes Vieira and Diogo Rosa Lã.
